services.name: Sandbanks River Country Campground
services.desc: Discover one of the most sought-after Sandbanks camping destinations in Prince Edward County at Sandbanks River Country Campground. Ideally located between the peaceful Outlet River and Sandbanks Provincial Park, our family-friendly campground offers easy access to the world-famous Sandbanks beaches, stunning freshwater sand dunes, and the natural beauty that makes Prince Edward County (PEC) a favourite Ontario summer getaway. Relax along the shores of Lake Ontario, explore the calm waters of East Lake, or set out on an outdoor adventure with boat, paddle board, kayak, and canoe rentals available onsite.
